    85  /-- A structure groupoid is a set of open partial homeomorphisms of a topological space stable under
    86  composition and inverse. They appear in the definition of the smoothness class of a manifold. -/
    87  structure StructureGroupoid (H : Type*) [TopologicalSpace H] where
    88    /-- Members of the structure groupoid are open partial homeomorphisms. -/
    89    members : Set (OpenPartialHomeomorph H H)
    90    /-- Structure groupoids are stable under composition. -/
    91    trans' : ∀ e e' : OpenPartialHomeomorph H H, e ∈ members → e' ∈ members → e ≫ₕ e' ∈ members
    92    /-- Structure groupoids are stable under inverse. -/
    93    symm' : ∀ e : OpenPartialHomeomorph H H, e ∈ members → e.symm ∈ members
    94    /-- The identity morphism lies in the structure groupoid. -/
    95    id_mem' : OpenPartialHomeomorph.refl H ∈ members
    96    /-- Let `e` be an open partial homeomorphism. If for every `x ∈ e.source`, the restriction of e
    97    to some open set around `x` lies in the groupoid, then `e` lies in the groupoid. -/
